facts.fact: The limits were revised by Ministry of MSME notification S.O. 1364(E) dated 21 March 2025
facts.quote: New Delhi, the 21st March, 2025 S.O. 1364(E).—In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (1) read with sub-section (9) of section 7

facts.fact: S.O. 1364(E) amends notification S.O. 2119(E) of 26 June 2020
facts.quote: hereby makes the following amendments in the notification of Government of India, Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises number S.O. 2119 (E), dated the 26 th June, 2020

facts.fact: The revised limits apply with effect from 1 April 2025
facts.quote: 2. This notification shall come into force with effect from the 1 st day of April, 2025.

facts.fact: The criterion is composite: investment in plant and machinery or equipment AND turnover
facts.quote: A composite criterion of investment and turnover shall apply for classification of an enterprise as micro, small or medium.

facts.fact: Micro: investment up to Rs 2.5 crore and turnover up to Rs 10 crore
facts.quote: A micro enterprise, where the investment does not exceed 2.5 crore rupees and turnover does not exceed 10 crore rupees.

facts.fact: Small: investment up to Rs 25 crore and turnover up to Rs 100 crore
facts.quote: A small enterprise, where the investment does not exceed 25 crore rupees and turnover does not exceed 100 crore rupees.

facts.fact: Medium: investment up to Rs 125 crore and turnover up to Rs 500 crore
facts.quote: A medium enterprise, where the investment does not exceed 125 crore rupees and turnover does not exceed 500 crore rupees.

facts.fact: The old limits before 01.04.2025 were Rs 1 crore / Rs 5 crore (micro), Rs 10 crore / Rs 50 crore (small) and Rs 50 crore / Rs 250 crore (medium)
facts.quote: Definition of MSMEs (Pre & Post 01-04-2025) Category Investment (₹ Crore) Turnover (₹ Crore) Old New Old New Micro 1 → 2.5 5 → 10 Small 10 → 25 50 → 100 Medium 50 → 125 250 → 500

facts.fact: If an enterprise crosses either the investment or the turnover limit of its category, it moves to the next higher category
facts.quote: If an enterprise crosses the ceiling limits specified for its present category in either of the two criteria of investment or turnover, it will cease to exist in that category and be placed in the next higher category

facts.fact: Exports are excluded when calculating turnover
facts.quote: Exports of goods or services or both, shall be excluded while calculating the turnover of any enterprise whether micro, small or medium, for the purposes of classification.

summary: All limits, the 01.04.2025 effective date, S.O. 1364(E)/2119(E), composite rule, next-category rule and export exclusion confirmed on udyamregistration.gov.in and the gazette PDF.
